diagram_previews.alt: Oblique view of the centre cube and the outer cube glued to one of its faces: the blue regular hexagon through six edge midpoints of the centre cube, and the orange triangle cut from the outer cube, which shares a side with the hexagon.
The cross-section: a blue regular hexagon with side sqrt(2)/2 and an orange equilateral triangle with side sqrt(2)/2 on each of its six sides, forming a six-pointed star.
